relations.text: ソリリスのバイオシミラーEPYSQLIを米国で販売する提携(2025年1月)
relations.text_en: Partnership to sell EPYSQLI, a Soliris biosimilar, in the U.S. (Jan 2025)

source.label: Teva 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 10, 2025, we announced that we entered into a strategic partnership with Samsung Bioepis for the commercialization of EPYSQLI ® (eculizumab), Samsung Bioepis's biosimilar to Soliris ® (eculizumab-aagh) in the U.S.

relations.text: アイリーアのバイオシミラーを欧州などで販売する提携(2025年1月)
relations.text_en: Collaboration to sell an Eylea biosimilar in Europe and other markets (Jan 2025)

source.label: Teva 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 13, 2025, we announced we entered into a collaboration agreement with Formycon for the commercialization of FYB203, Formycon's biosimilar candidate to Eylea ® (aflibercept) in Europe (excluding Italy)

companies.name: プレステージ・バイオファーマ

relations.text: ハーセプチンのバイオシミラーを欧州で販売する提携(2025年10月)
relations.text_en: Collaboration to sell a Herceptin biosimilar in Europe (Oct 2025)

source.label: Teva 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 20, 2025, we announced we entered into a collaboration agreement with Prestige Biopharma for the commercialization of Tuznue ® , Prestige's biosimilar to Herceptin ® (trastuzumab), across a majority of European markets.
